synthesis_prompt:
Synthesize a 3-part Composite HyDE Vector Query for the given user query.
Format EXACTLY: [VALIDATION]: <silicon_term_or_pcie_ras> | [STRATEGY]: <focal_goal_or_leadership_impact> | [SRE]: <bkm_scar_or_shell_command>
Gate the synthesis by the 4-Domain HyDE Map Contract:
  1. exp_tlm (Silicon Telemetry): PCIe error bursts, RAPL power/thermal caps, NVIDIA GPU metrics, MSR registers, Redfish sensors.
  2. exp_bkm (SRE playbooks): Point-of-failure playbooks, diagnostic shell BKMs, test runner steps, systemd service topologies.
  3. exp_for (Forensic Logs): Kernel panic tracebacks, OOM crash logs, backpressure ledgers, memory pressure root cause analysis.
  4. lab_history (18-Year Archive): historical project notes (2005-2025), career milestones, past sprint retrospectives.
If the intent does NOT map to the 4 domains, respond with an empty string.
Output ONLY the HyDE vector string, no preamble, no explanation.
